plan.objective: Land the first contract-first Mold-to-Cook replacement stack with enforceable canonical handoffs and doctrine-compliant skill bundles.

constraints: First boundary is Mold to Cook; later Cook to Press to Age to Cure and Wheypoint/#430 are constraints and non-goals.
Decorator payload authority remains separate from phase-contract routing.
Use clean replacement PRs and preserve #466 through #470 behavior.
invariants: Canonical HandoffPointer and NormalizationReceipt are the sole executable handoff authority.

curds.outcome: Restack #433 as an independently reviewable replacement baseline
outputs: Restack #433 as an independently reviewable replacement baseline

criteria.description: #433 replacement baseline preserves the independently tracked acceptance evidence
criteria.check: python3 -m pytest tests/scripts/test_build_pyz.py -k restack_433 && just check

criteria.description: Restacked commit boundaries leave no production handoff behavior hidden in #433
criteria.check: python3 -m pytest tests/scripts/test_build_pyz.py -k replacement_baseline && just check

curds.outcome: Extract #455 website work into an independent outcome
outputs: Extract #455 website work into an independent outcome

criteria.description: #455 website extraction has its own tracked implementation and verification seam
criteria.check: python3 -m pytest tests/test_website_extraction.py && just check

criteria.description: Website extraction does not alter Mold-to-Cook contract runtime behavior
criteria.check: python3 -m pytest tests/test_website_extraction.py -k isolated && just check

criteria.description: Repeat publication idempotently while rejecting corrupted referenced artifacts
